cards.title: Oral AUC Prediction Limitations
cards.claim: Prediction of oral AUC was consistent with i.v. CL predictions, but the greatest challenge was estimating human bioavailability (F).
conditions: Applicable when predicting oral exposure from preclinical data
limitations: Abstract does not detail methods for estimating F
High uncertainty in F estimation limits oral AUC prediction accuracy
cards.downstream_use: Highlighting uncertainty in oral exposure predictions; justifying IV-only simulations if F cannot be reliably estimated

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
